content.comment_body: I'm unable to connect the [product_name] Web Editor to my [product_name] device even though the IP configuration appears to be correct. The software is not detecting the hardware.

Hello [user_name], welcome! Please write your questions in English to ensure better community support, as this is an international forum. Here is a translation of your inquiry. Regards, [user_name]_Moderator
Is the installed mSD card on the [product_name] formatted to FAT32 and with a maximum size of 32 GB?
I previously had this issue and resolved it by updating the firmware on both the [product_name] controller and the [product_name] communication module to the latest versions.
You didn't mention anything about the communication module in your initial comment ...
Sorry! I mistakenly assumed the devices were being connected via the communication module.
Hi, but that wasn't the solution in your own topic, was it?

Actually, it was. My [product_name] and the communication module are now communicating successfully after firmware updates, and I can send text messages. However, in another post, I'm encountering issues with data connection over LTE using a SIM card with a static public IP. Any help would be great.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report difficulty connecting the [product_name] Web Editor to their [product_name] device, even when IP settings are correct. Firmware updates resolved similar issues for some, but did not address the primary connection problem for the original poster. Questions about hardware requirements, such as SD card formatting and capacity, and whether the communication module is part of the setup, are being raised. There is some confusion about the exact devices and configuration involved.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects the [product_name] Web Editor to reliably detect and connect to the [product_name] device when network settings are correct.
